variant: with Universal Robots UR5e arm (module MAN01-02)
name: Husarion Panther with UR5e
summary: Husarion's rugged four-wheel outdoor UGV Panther (IP54, IP66 option, up to 120 kg payload) with a Universal Robots UR5e arm mounted on its rails and the arm controller built into the chassis.

germany.statusNote: Husarion (Poland) offers the UR5e manipulator module for the Panther and quotes through a request form; Génération Robots sells the Panther base from 20,000 € net (10 to 12 weeks) and says it can be fitted with a robotic arm.

sellers.name: Husarion S.A.
sellers.note: "Request a quote" form on the Panther overview page; the Panther + UR5e set ships in two boxes and is assembled by the customer following Husarion's guide.

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Panther base (no arm) from 20,000 € excl. VAT / 24,000 € incl. VAT, "Delivery within 10 to 12 weeks"; arm on request.

specs.label: Max carrying capacity (base)
specs.conditions: base platform; the arm counts towards it; Génération Robots states 100 kg

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: 3.5 to 16 h depending on battery and load; base figure

specs.label: Water protection
specs.conditions: IP66 is an option (Génération Robots: "IP54 (optional IP66)")

specs.label: Hill climb
specs.conditions: with 100 kg cargo; 44 deg with 52 kg

specs.label: Base size (L x W x H)
specs.quote: dimensions (L x W x H)0.81 x 0.85 x 0.37 m

specs.label: Arm
specs.value: Universal Robots UR5e, mounted on reinforced rails, controller inside the Panther
specs.quote: The arm controller has been integrated into the interior of the Panther.

capabilities.sdk: ROS 2 (software for the UR5e on Husarion's GitHub)
notes: Payload, runtime, IP and slope are base figures; with the UR5e mounted the free payload is lower.
Husarion also documents a Franka Research 3 on the Panther; this record is the UR5e module.
Customer assembles the arm onto the base (two-person job per Husarion).
